Author: Nexai
Name: FCCH
Description: Free Company Chest Helper. Automate deposits, withdrawals, and organization. Manage crystals, custom lists, and workshop projects.
Punchline: You ain't savin these slots, you puttin em to work.
Changelog:
- Fix: Enforce IncludeInDepositAll guard in CrystalManager.DepositDuplicates

- Improvement: Reduced chat verbosity. Moved queued/processing messages to Verbose mode, condensed indexing output.
